# Shared ZZZ UI kit (copied, do not edit)

These files come from the wallpaper repository (github.com/Garruvex/zzz-wallpaper-media-integration) at the
commit in kit-pin.json. Change them there, commit, then run from the wallpaper
checkout:

    node tools/export-ui-kit.cjs --companion <this checkout>

A test fails if a file here differs from its pinned hash.
